lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Pi Network is building a secure, decentralized blockchain with proof-of-stake, not proof-of-work — it’s the future of cryptocurrency.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Pi’s protocol is unproven, with no real-world use cases. It’s just a mobile app with no transaction history or real value.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Over 30 million users are already on the network, and its consensus mechanism is designed for scalability and energy efficiency.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: That’s just hype. Pi has no real-world adoption, no merchant support, and no actual transactions — it’s a pyramid scheme in disguise.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Pi is a scam. It’s not a real cryptocurrency — it’s just a get-rich-quick scheme with no real value or utility.
